> position = "dodge") + facet_grid(Score ~ Type) + theme_bw()
> print(a)
>

> Calls: print ... <Anonymous> -> <Anonymous> -> <Anonymous> -> <Anonymous>
> Execution halted

I got an error with your code, but not the same one you got. In your
code, the call to geom_errorbar doesn't make sense. Score is a factor
(and so doesn't make sense being plotted on the scale that was created
by Mean) and Error is not defined in your data. The following did
work for me:

qplot(Methods, Mean, fill = factor(Number),
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = Mean + SD, ymin = Mean - SD),

Number must be a factor in your data.frame; maybe it was in yours, but
that isn't clear how you presented the data.

Finally, I'm under obligation to make the warning to not make a
"dynamite plot":
